title: Teen Crashes During Police Chase, Gets Busted With Hallucinogenic Drugs
description:
On February 6, 2022, a 17-year-old driver nearly struck a marked squad car in Stevens Point, WI. The officer attempted to conduct multiple traffic stops on the vehicle but the suspect continued to flee. Eventually, they were able to pit the suspect’s vehicle causing him to spin out and surrender to police.
